channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Al Jefferson | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Al Jefferson from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Draymond Green on Al Jefferson, Elton Brand
item.description:
Ahmed/The Ears/IG: BigBizTheGod ??: Kenyon Martin says he could name 200 players that are better players than Draymond Green:

“That man’s individual body of work is cool but I can list 200 players that’s better than Draymond Green, is he better than LeMarcus Aldridge, Al Jefferson or Elton Brand I can go all day”

Draymond Green on Al Jefferson, Elton Brand, Jul 17, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Grant Williams on Al Jefferson, Kevin Garnett
item.description:
Williams explained that Brown having his name mentioned as the potential centerpiece in a deal for Durant just shows how great the Celtics star is.

“It kind of shows how valuable he is. The fact that, top-10 player in the world, you’re the focal point. It’s one of those things, I remember, back in the day with Al Jefferson and KG [Kevin Garnett].It’s one of those things where you’re like, ‘oh dang, Al Jefferson.’ It’s not even like a difference,”

Grant Williams on Al Jefferson, Kevin Garnett, Aug 13, 2022. Source: Heavy.com.

item.title: Kevin Pritchard on Al Jefferson
item.description:
Jim Ayello:Kevin Pritchard on Al Jefferson:

“Al meant more to us than he did to any other team. He's like our most important player.... He's not playing much, but the influence he has on our team is gripping. He really has team's ear. Didn't want to take a player like that off our team.”

Kevin Pritchard on Al Jefferson, Feb 11, 2018. Source: Twitter @jimayello.

item.title: Hassan Whiteside on Al Jefferson
item.description:
Ethan J. Skolnick:Hassan Whiteside:

“I feel like I had a great job on Jefferson.... It's not like he's averaging 30 in the series. Jefferson is not the problem.”

Hassan Whiteside on Al Jefferson, Apr 28, 2016. Source: Twitter @EthanJSkolnick.

item.title: LeBron James on Al Jefferson, Kemba Walker
item.description:
Michael Scotto:LeBron James on the Charlotte Bobcats:

“They're a team on the uprise. We saw it with Big Al (Jefferson) and Kemba Walker.”

LeBron James on Al Jefferson, Kemba Walker, Apr 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @MikeAScotto.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Al Jefferson
item.description:
Rod Boone:Paul Pierce:

“Al Jefferson, no one on the planet can guard him. I mean, sh--. We tried to double him, triple, single.”

Paul Pierce on Al Jefferson, Mar 26, 2014. Source: Twitter @rodboone.

item.title: Pau Gasol on Al Jefferson
item.description:
Mike Trudell:Gasol on stopping Jefferson:

“Make him have to work for the shot, don't let him get into the paint w/out contesting ... Utilize my length.”

Pau Gasol on Al Jefferson, Dec 15, 2013. Source: Twitter @LakersReporter.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Al Jefferson
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Clifford on Jefferson:

“I think it would be unlikely he plays tomorrow... Hopefully he practices Thursday and plays Friday.”

Steve Clifford on Al Jefferson, Nov 19, 2013. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Steve Clifford on Al Jefferson
item.description:
Steve Clifford:

“We have a premier low-post scorer (in free agent Al Jefferson), which not many teams have. And we have depth – those would be the two things that stick out to me.”

Steve Clifford on Al Jefferson, Sep 20, 2013. Source: Raleigh News & Observer.

item.title: Kemba Walker on Al Jefferson
item.description:
Rick Bonnell:Kemba Walker on Bobcats adding Al Jefferson:

“Was I excited? I almost shredded a tear. That's what we need.”

Kemba Walker on Al Jefferson, Jul 9, 2013. Source: Twitter @rick_bonnell.

item.title: Kevin O'Connor on Al Jefferson
item.description:
Steve Luhm:Kevin O'Connor on Al Jefferson:

“I feel like he's done everything coach asked him to do. He put the work in. Now he's reaping the rewards.”

Kevin O'Connor on Al Jefferson, Apr 25, 2012. Source: Twitter.
